_about: Persistent memory for the drift detector (kb/_build_governance_candidates.py). 'mapped' = this surface is ALREADY covered by an existing register row. 'dismissed' = it needs no row, and why. Anything in neither is proposed as a candidate. Dismissal lives here, not in a database, so the REASON is reviewable in a diff and cannot silently diverge from the register it annotates.

dismissed.table:cpl_library: The Library tab's register of decks, films and documents (Sam, 2026-10-05: build it; files live in the team Drive). Each row is a link and its metadata, never the file. Read and written only under the team phrase or a reviewer sign-in (team_pass_ok() or is_allowed_reviewer()), the same audience as the tab; no anon read, no delete policy, delete and truncate revoked. Every edit files the prior row in cpl_library_history through a trigger, so a write is reversible from the database (Rule 10 a2). It carries no student or staff detail beyond the name a teammate types as added_by or updated_by. Who decides a piece's audience is Sam: a public file with no audience set shows under Needs attention until he rules, so the decision right already has its owner and needs no register row. A second writer, the session-side filer scripts/library_file.py (Sam's calls 7-8, 2026-10-05), records each file it puts in Drive: a receipt applied as a named migration, guarded on the Drive file id so a second apply changes nothing, under updated_by library-filer@bot, with the history trigger keeping the prior row. It writes the link, the version list and home, moves a Requested record to Draft on its first draft and changes no other status, and never sets an audience, so Sam's two decision rights stay his.
dismissed.workflow:program-source-census.yml: The program-source census (Phase 0 of the program requirements harvest), weekly. It reads public college websites from a runner under Sam's sheet-23 call 5 (2026-10-03) and writes only program_source_registry, through program_source_census_apply(), which never overwrites a row a person corrected and files every prior row in program_source_registry_history, and (since S326, Sam's go on open-asks sheet 29 card 5) program_source_addenda, through program_source_addenda_apply(), which lists the catalog addenda it sees, marks one gone only after a complete read, never touches a row a person corrected, and files every prior row in program_source_addenda_history. It feeds no public surface and carries no staff or student detail. It earns a cadence row when Phase 1 names the person who checks the pilot sample (the lane's open item); a college-facing correction surface goes through Governance before it ships.

dismissed.table:map_college_credit_statewide: Real statewide credit totals (one row), rebuilt nightly inside map_promote_custom_reports() by rebuild_map_college_credit_summary(); no human writer and no new audience. dismissed.table:cpl_reflections: A journaling surface whose audience is its own authors: written from the First Light page, read only by the weekly digest that goes back to the same team. No third party relies on it, nothing downstream publishes it, and burdening it with decision rights would discourage the writing it exists for. Reversible if the digest ever grows an outside audience. (Sam's ruling, 2026-08-30, the Fifteen Tables.)
dismissed.artifact-store:decision-sheet-replies: A decision sheet's reply store (the Claude artifact's own db, added 2026-09-05 by kb/_decision_sheet_replies.py) holds Sam's verdicts, notes and follow-up flags on that one sheet. The artifact is his, organization-internal, and the only writers are the people he opens the sheet to; sessions READ it (Artifact read_db) and execute the verdicts into the registers, which carry their own decision rights. A right over the reply store would restate 'Sam decides'.
dismissed.column:map_colleges.swp_region: Strong Workforce region added to the college taxonomy on 2026-09-16 at Sam's direction. No new decision right: it is a DERIVED attribute of an entity the College & district identity lane already governs, computed from college_geo.county by a rule written down in kb/reference/swp_region_map.json, and it introduces no new writer — map_colleges has no automated writer and is curated. Reversible by dropping the two columns, since every pre-existing value was null. If the region ever becomes hand-editable per college, that IS a decision right and needs a register row.

dismissed.table:program_record_verdicts: A reviewer's reading of a program record (Confirm or Needs a fix), written from the Program Requirements tab's Records view. Sam ruled the write himself (Open Asks Sheet 51 card 1, 'build', 2026-10-08, on the mock-up Program Records Review). The gate is technical and stated: only program_record_verdict_add writes, as an allowed reviewer (is_allowed_reviewer()), with the session's email, never an argument. The criterion is written down: the tab's four checks, three of them machine checks the server applies (program_record_machine_pass), and Confirm turns a record checked only while the fingerprint of the requirements the page showed still matches. The log is append-only (reads only for the page's roles; undo is a new row), and a Needs a fix note lands on the college's reading procedure through program_source_procedure_set, whose history keeps the prior record. It names staff emails, so the read is reviewer-only; it holds no student grain, so the student-detail ADR does not reach it. Decision owner: the CPL Initiative (Sam).
dismissed.rpc:program_record_verdict_add: The one write to program_record_verdicts (see table:program_record_verdicts): security definer, is_allowed_reviewer() first, the fingerprint refused when it no longer matches, closed to anon (revoke from public, anon, authenticated; execute for authenticated and service_role). Sam, Open Asks Sheet 51 card 1, 2026-10-08.
